description: Small docs-QA eval set for timing measurement. Replace with your own corpus when you have one; shape stays the same.

items.input: How do I rotate the API key for a service account?
items.actual_output: Go to Settings > Service Accounts, select the account, and click 'Rotate key'. The old key stays valid for 24 hours to allow rollover.
items.expected_output: Rotate it from Settings > Service Accounts; the previous key remains valid for 24 hours.
retrieval_context: Service account keys can be rotated from Settings > Service Accounts. Select the account and choose 'Rotate key'.
After rotation, the previous key remains valid for a 24-hour grace period to allow clients to roll over.

items.input: What is the maximum file size for document uploads?
items.actual_output: Documents up to 50 MB can be uploaded. Larger files should be split or uploaded via the bulk import API.
items.expected_output: 50 MB per document; use the bulk import API for larger files.
retrieval_context: The document upload endpoint accepts files up to 50 MB.
For files exceeding the upload limit, use the bulk import API, which supports chunked transfers.

items.input: Does the webhook retry on failure?
items.actual_output: Yes. Failed webhook deliveries are retried with exponential backoff up to 5 times over roughly 30 minutes.
items.expected_output: Yes, up to 5 retries with exponential backoff (~30 minutes total).
retrieval_context: Webhook deliveries that fail with a non-2xx response are retried up to 5 times.
Retries use exponential backoff; the final attempt occurs approximately 30 minutes after the first failure.

items.input: Can I restrict sign-ins to my company domain?
items.actual_output: Yes, enable 'Domain restriction' under Security settings and add your allowed domains.
items.expected_output: Yes — Security settings > Domain restriction, then list allowed domains.
retrieval_context: Administrators can enable Domain restriction in Security settings to limit sign-ins to approved email domains.
Multiple domains can be added to the allowlist.

items.input: How long are audit logs retained?
items.actual_output: Audit logs are retained for 90 days on the standard plan and 365 days on enterprise.
retrieval_context: Audit log retention is 90 days for standard plans.
Enterprise plans retain audit logs for 365 days and support export to SIEM tools.

items.input: Is there a rate limit on the search endpoint?
items.actual_output: The search endpoint is limited to 60 requests per minute per API key; bursts above that return HTTP 429.
items.expected_output: 60 requests/minute per key; exceeding it returns 429.
retrieval_context: Search API requests are limited to 60 per minute per API key.
Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

items.input: Can two people edit the same document at once?
items.actual_output: Yes, real-time co-editing is supported; changes merge automatically and conflicts are resolved last-writer-wins per field.
items.expected_output: Yes — real-time co-editing with automatic merging.
retrieval_context: Documents support real-time collaborative editing.
Concurrent edits are merged automatically; conflicting field-level edits resolve last-writer-wins.

items.input: How do I export all my project data?
items.actual_output: Use Project Settings > Export to download a ZIP containing all documents, metadata, and attachments. Exports over 1 GB are emailed as a link.
items.expected_output: Project Settings > Export produces a ZIP; large exports arrive as an emailed link.
retrieval_context: A full project export is available under Project Settings > Export and produces a ZIP archive of documents, metadata, and attachments.
Exports larger than 1 GB are prepared asynchronously and delivered as a download link by email.

items.input: What happens to shared links when a document is archived?
items.actual_output: Shared links stop resolving when a document is archived; restoring the document reactivates them.
items.expected_output: Links stop working while archived; restoring the document reactivates them.
retrieval_context: Archiving a document deactivates its shared links.
Restoring an archived document reactivates previously created shared links.

items.input: Does the SDK support async requests in Python?
items.actual_output: Yes, the Python SDK ships an AsyncClient with the same interface as the sync client.
items.expected_output: Yes — use AsyncClient, which mirrors the sync client interface.
retrieval_context: The Python SDK provides both Client and AsyncClient.
AsyncClient mirrors the synchronous interface; all methods are awaitable.
